title: What to Know About ChatGPT Ads

facts.fact: OpenAI officially began testing ads inside ChatGPT for United States users on the Free and Go tiers (per the page's account, the beta launched February 9, 2026).
facts.quote: OpenAI officially began testing ads inside ChatGPT for United States users on the Free and Go tiers.

facts.fact: The page limits the initial ChatGPT ads test to logged-in adult U.S. users, and says Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Education plans remain ad-free.
facts.quote: Limited to logged-in adult U.S. users

facts.fact: Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Education plans remain ad-free, according to the page.
facts.quote: Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Education plans remain ad-free

facts.fact: The page says ads appear below the AI's response and are clearly labeled.
facts.quote: Ads appear below the AI’s response and are clearly labeled

facts.fact: Reporting for advertisers is limited to aggregate metrics such as impressions and clicks, according to the page.
facts.quote: Reporting is limited to aggregate metrics such as impressions and clicks

facts.fact: Reported CPMs for ChatGPT ads are approximately $60, which the page says is roughly three times typical social platform averages (third-party reporting, not the vendor's own figure).
facts.quote: Reported CPMs are approximately $60, roughly three times the typical social platform averages

facts.fact: Brands reportedly had to commit between $200,000 and $250,000 to participate in the ChatGPT ads beta (per reporting cited on the page).
facts.quote: Brands reportedly must commit between $200,000 and $250,000 to participate in the beta

facts.fact: OpenAI was reportedly rolling out self-serve ad tools in April 2026 that would remove the minimum commitment requirement.
facts.quote: OpenAI is reportedly rolling out self-serve tools in April 2026 that remove the minimum commitment requirement

facts.fact: The page says OpenAI was on track to launch self-serve ad tools that eliminate the $200,000+ minimum commitment.
facts.quote: OpenAI is on track to launch self-serve ad tools that eliminate the $200,000+ minimum commitment

facts.fact: The page says OpenAI began introducing cost-per-click (CPC) pricing alongside its initial CPM model.
facts.quote: the company is beginning to introduce cost-per-click (CPC) pricing alongside its initial CPM model

facts.fact: OpenAI announced plans to expand its ad pilot beyond the United States to Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.
facts.quote: including Canada, Australia, and New Zealand

facts.fact: OpenAI announced a further ad expansion on May 7, 2026 into the United Kingdom, Mexico, Brazil, Japan, and South Korea.
facts.value: United Kingdom, Mexico, Brazil, Japan, South Korea
facts.quote: they are expanding into the United Kingdom, Mexico, Brazil, Japan, and South Korea

facts.fact: Leaked internal financial models reportedly projected $1 billion in 2026 revenue from free user monetization (leaked reporting, not confirmed by OpenAI on the page).
facts.quote: Leaked internal financial models projected $1 billion in 2026 revenue from “free user monetization.”

facts.fact: In late 2024, OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar stated there were no active plans for an ad-supported ChatGPT.
facts.quote: stated there were “no active plans” for an ad-supported ChatGPT.

facts.fact: Developers dissecting the ChatGPT Android app beta v1.2025.329 in late November 2025 found references to ad-related features.
facts.quote: developers dissecting the ChatGPT Android app beta (v1.2025.329)

facts.fact: The page says OpenAI paused its ad initiative on December 2–3, 2025, just days after ad-related code surfaced.
facts.quote: Just days after ad-related code surfaced, OpenAI paused the initiative.
